conversation.message: Hi there, it's really nice to meet you. How have you been feeling lately, in general, and what's something you've been enjoying or looking forward to these days?

Honestly? It’s been tough. Work has been crazy, and I just feel drained all the time. I used to love going to the gym, but even that feels like a chore right now. I guess I just need a break or something.
That sounds really tough, and I appreciate you sharing that with me. Have you been feeling more down or pessimistic about things lately, and has your sleep changed at all?
Yeah, definitely more down. I wake up in the middle of the night and just lie there thinking about bills and work and stuff. It’s hard to switch off.

That sounds exhausting, and I’m glad you’re sharing this with me. Sleep disruptions can really amplify how things feel. Have you also noticed any trouble concentrating at work or finding it hard to make even small decisions lately?
Yeah, it’s like my brain is just mush. I get to the office and I’m staring at a spreadsheet and I just can’t focus. It takes me five times longer to do things than it used to.

That sounds really tough, given the sleep disruption and concentration issues. Have you been noticing more pessimistic thoughts about the future or feeling indecisive lately? And have you seen any changes in your appetite or how you’re eating?

Yeah, I guess I am. I look at my 30s and I’m just like, 'Is this it? Is this what the rest of my life is going to be?' It’s scary. As for eating, I just haven't had the energy to cook, so I've just been eating takeout or nothing.
That sounds exhausting; thank you for sharing how hard things feel. How often do you find yourself having trouble making even small decisions, and how long has this been going on?
It’s pretty much every day. And honestly, I don't know how much longer I can keep going like this. It’s been months, maybe? I just feel stuck, you know?

That sounds really heavy; thank you for sharing all of that. Do you notice any guilt about things you've done, or find yourself being extra hard on yourself, or moments when you dislike yourself, and have you cried more often lately?

Yeah, I definitely beat myself up over things. I'm always like, 'You're 30, grow up,' you know? And yeah, I've cried a few times. It’s embarrassing, but I guess it’s just what happens when you feel like you're losing control.
That sounds really heavy, and I appreciate you sharing how hard things have been. Have you been noticing more agitation or irritability lately, and do you also have moments where you feel worthless?

Yeah, I'm just... on edge. I get annoyed at my friends for being happy, and I know that’s not fair. And yeah, I definitely feel worthless. I look at my life and I'm just like, 'What is the point of any of it?'
That sounds really heavy, and I appreciate you sharing how hard you’ve been on yourself. When those self-critical thoughts come up, how often do they happen, and how long has this been going on?
Constantly. It’s every day. And honestly? I don't know how much longer I can keep going like this. It’s been months, maybe? I just feel like I’m stuck in a loop.

That sounds really heavy, and I appreciate you sharing how hard this has been. It’s clear you’ve been dealing with a lot of self-criticism and feelings of worthlessness, which I’m glad you’re opening up about. How often do these self-critical thoughts come up for you on a typical day?
I don't know, maybe 10 times? 20? It’s constant. I wake up thinking it, I'm in the shower thinking it, I'm at work thinking it. I just feel like I'm the worst person in the world.
That sounds really heavy, and I appreciate you sharing that. You mentioned feeling down lately—how long has this sadness been going on?
Months? A year? I don't know. It just feels like this is who I am now. It's like I'm just stuck in this rut and I don't know how to get out of it.
That sounds really tough. When you’re faced with even small decisions, how much is this indecisiveness slowing you down or affecting things at work and in your daily life?
It’s everything. I used to be able to just go with the flow, but now I’m overthinking every little thing. It’s like my brain is just stuck on repeat.

Thank you so much for sharing so openly today. I really appreciate your honesty and the courage it took to talk about what you’ve been going through. Take care of yourself, and I’m wishing you strength and calm as you move forward.
